quoted.text: Counter to what eveyone keeps saying I do think Mendoza ends up playing at least half the games this season for LV. Teams love to shout how they are going to be different and sit rookie QBs all season but we know that very rarely happens unless u are on a Playoff level team (ie GB with Rodgers/Love & KC with Smith/Mahomes). With that being said it is interesting that 1st rd rookie QBs tend to perform worse from a baseline perspective vs all other teams with the same win totals. However their right tail/upside outcomes are much longer (>3 wins v WT 20% of the time) than those other tms and their really poor outcomes are skinner/less frequent. Meaning, tms like the Raiders if they go over their win total are more likely to really go over than other teams in that 5.5-6 range.
